description:
Skill Java, Tomcat, Spring, API, Micro-services, Kafka, NoSQL, JSON 
 Location Portland, OR 
 Total Experience 3 yrs. 
 Max Salary Not Mentioned 
 Employment Type Direct Jobs (Full Time) 
 Domain Any 
 Description 
 OPT and EAD can apply  
 
 
 Primary Duties & Responsibilities:  
 
 
 Implement  
 
 
 High performance, resilient APIs  
 Micro-services and hierarchical web-services  
 Distributed, and parallel tools and services  
 Do all of this on systems ranging from a public or private cloud to a decent laptop  
 Ingest, Process and Deliver  
 
 
 Large quantities of disparate data types  
 Large files, small files, such as JSON metadata files, video files, HSI imagery, satellite, aerial or unmanned aircraft data.  
 High volume & bitrate content streams such as those from UHD drone videos or aerial imagery, as well as micro-record streams such as those from well-heads or residential sensors  
 Grow with the company and expand your role alongside fulfilling existing needs  
 
 
 Knowledge - Skills & Abilities Required:  
 
 
 Must have experience with:  
 
 
 Server-side Java programming  
 
 
 Tomcat, Spring framework & other Java dev environments  
 
 
 Micro-services, API (REST, JSON) implementation  
 
 
 Installation, configuration, deployment and utilization of some or all of:  
 
 
 Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar products  
 NoSQL products (e.g.Cassandra)  
 Lucene, Solr or similar products  
 Docker or similar products  
 3rd party tool integration  
 
 
 JSON, XML, data movement and manipulation  
 
 
 API specification and schema authoring and editing  
 
 
 Configuration management  
 
 
 Continuous integration & delivery  
 

 Nice to have experience with:  
 
 
 JNI  
 
 
 Video, maps, GIS  
 
 
 AWS APIs, S3 APIs  
 
 
 Using APIs and automating with APIs  
 
 
 OpenStack tools  
 
 
 JavaScript, Node, Angular 


 Multiple Openings
